title: A minimal prime of the support of a finite module over a Noetherian ring is associated
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $\operatorname{Supp}(M)$ be the set of prime ideals $\mathfrak p\subset R$ with $M_{\mathfrak p}\neq0$, where $M_{\mathfrak p}$ is the localization of $M$ at $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Let $\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Supp}(M)$ be minimal in $\operatorname{Supp}(M)$: no $\mathfrak q'\in\operatorname{Supp}(M)$ satisfies $\mathfrak q'\subsetneq\mathfrak q$. Then $\mathfrak q$ is an associated prime of $M$: there is $z\in M$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_R(z)=\{a\in R: az=0\}=\mathfrak q$.
